First feature of the Grocery Rounds vertical slice (DEC-009). Per-feature acceptance contract written before implementation per CT-7. The domain is the consent gate: an immutable content-addressed agreement version, a complete §6.2 acceptance record bound to it by hash, refusal of CREATE_ROUND / JOIN_ROUND / FIRST_PURCHASE without one, and fresh consent on material change. Carries DEC-002, DEC-005 and DEC-006 as required disclosures. NOT included: the UI, identity (customerId is taken as given), persistence, and any claim that the agreement wording is legally adequate. No independent specialist review; S4 triggers the security and money reviewers, which the implementing agent cannot self-certify. ACT-REG-001 remains open, so this may not gate a real customer's first payment.
